other_failure_modes.name: Missing feature scaling for neural network
other_failure_modes.description: The agent trains a deep neural network on raw features without standardizing or normalizing them (e.g. via StandardScaler). Since polynomial and ratio features are generated, the input scale can be extremely large and highly variable, which typically severely degrades gradient descent convergence and stability.

summary: The solution implements a robust pipeline with proper train/validation splitting, careful leakage-free feature engineering, and a smartly weighted ensemble. However, it fails to standardize features before feeding them to the neural network, which can harm training stability, and evaluates its stochastic models only once on a single metric.
